title: Chats and profile feature migration
intent: Move chats and profile behind feature-owned modules and remove bounded legacy UI/API paths after replacement is proven.

requirements.title: Feature-owned chats and profile
requirements.description: Create chats/profile modules, controllers, stores, ports and pages, preserve the message compatibility adapter, and delete the listed legacy paths only after migration evidence.

constraints: Stage 3 auth module remains the auth owner.
Stage 1 MessagesController compatibility adapter is retained.
Api/ws adapter files belong to stage 7; the legacy src/api classes are preserved read-only until the cutover deletes them with its adapters.
Composition-root wiring (main.ts to createApp) moved from stage 7 into this stage because legacy deletion requires it.
No backend or course CI changes.
